meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成原创视觉设计图片和PDF文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、艺术图或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create original visual art and PDF documents from descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, artwork, or static visual designs.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会先产出一份 4~6 段的设计哲学 .md 文件,再把它表达成单页 .pdf 或 .png 视觉作品:以图形、色彩、空间为主,文字只作少量点缀。它只输出 .md、.pdf、.png 三类文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作海报、艺术作品或其他静态视觉设计时触发;它会先写设计哲学,再据此绘图。所有产出均为原创,不复制现有艺术家的作品。

say.text: 帮我做一张关于深海探索的海报,存成 PNG。
say.note: 先生成设计哲学,再输出单页 PNG

say.text: 把这个概念写成 4~6 段设计哲学 .md,再画成一页 PDF。
say.note: 先出 .md,再出 PDF 画布

say.text: 按同样的哲学再做三页,收进同一个 PDF。
say.note: 多页作品合并到一个 PDF

howto.what_en: After install, Claude first writes a 4-6 paragraph design philosophy as a .md file, then expresses it visually as a single downloadable .pdf or .png page that is mostly graphics, color and space, with minimal text. It only outputs .md, .pdf and .png files.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to create a poster, a piece of art, or another static design. It writes a design philosophy first, then draws from it, and keeps all work original rather than copying existing artists.

say_en.text: Make a poster about deep-sea exploration and save it as a PNG.
say_en.note: Writes a design philosophy, then one PNG page

say_en.text: Turn this concept into a 4-6 paragraph design philosophy .md, then a one-page PDF.
say_en.note: Philosophy .md first, then the PDF canvas

say_en.text: Add three more pages in the same philosophy and bundle them into one PDF.
say_en.note: Extra pages merged into one PDF
